purpose: Results this repository has confirmed hold wrong content. An entry withdraws a result from current delivery. It does not delete it, re-sign it, or relabel it as a structural non-applicability: the original Run stays readable so the defect can be demonstrated and the repair checked.

defects.summary: 26 of 58 excerpts are executive-officer biography from the Form 10-K unnumbered Part I item, labelled EXPLICIT_LEGAL_SECTION_TEXT because ITEM_3 ran past that item to ITEM 5.
defects.repair: scripts/vnext/historical_text_results.py closes a numbered item at the form's unnumbered Part I item

defects.summary: Item 3 incorporates Note 16A by reference. The sub-note is now located: Note 16 carries 'A. Legal Proceedings' with B (guarantees), C (commitments), D (contingent consideration) and E (insurance) after it, and the scope runs from A to B. Correctly scoped, the excerpt set is 92 items and 41,860 characters against the Spec's max_items 64 and max_text_chars 64,000, so create_deterministic_text_candidate refuses with TEXT_V2_COMPLETE_EXCERPT_SET_EXCEEDS_ITEM_BOUND and this coordinate produces no result.
defects.repair: scripts/vnext/historical_text_results.incorporated_scopes locates the lettered sub-note; the remaining blocker is the Spec's item bound

blocking_decision.question: whether D02's max_items may be raised in a successor MetricSpec
blocking_decision.why_it_is_a_business_decision: max_items caps block count, and block count is a function of how the filer breaks paragraphs rather than of how much is disclosed. Raising it changes an approved MetricSpec, so it goes through the revision mechanism rather than being edited here.
